name: yoyopdf
description: YOYOPDF - browser-first PDF/image tools. Static multi-page site (no app bundle); Vite here only builds/serves the existing HTML/CSS/JS as-is and Vitest runs smoke tests.

scripts.build: npm run seo:check && vite build && npm run verify:dist
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
